title: As COP31 Opens, Climate Data Must Reach Communities

sources.name: World Meteorological Organization (WMO)
sources.title: WMO at the 31st Conference of Parties (COP31) to the UNFCCC

paragraphs.en: The COP31 climate conference began on November 9, 2026,
paragraphs.zh: COP31氣候大會於2026年11月9日開始，

paragraphs.en: in Antalya, Turkey,
paragraphs.zh: 地點在土耳其安塔利亞，

paragraphs.en: with meetings scheduled to continue until November 20.
paragraphs.zh: 會議預定持續至11月20日。

paragraphs.en: On the opening day,
paragraphs.zh: 在開幕當天，

paragraphs.en: the World Meteorological Organization, or WMO,
paragraphs.zh: 世界氣象組織，也就是WMO，

paragraphs.en: released a climate update.
paragraphs.zh: 發布了一份氣候現況更新報告。

paragraphs.en: Its message connected rising climate risks
paragraphs.zh: 報告的訊息將升高的氣候風險

paragraphs.en: with the practical need for better forecasts and warnings.
paragraphs.zh: 與改善預報及預警的實際需求連結起來。

paragraphs.en: WMO expects 2026 to be
paragraphs.zh: WMO預期2026年將成為

paragraphs.en: one of the four warmest years on record.
paragraphs.zh: 有紀錄以來最熱的四個年份之一。

paragraphs.en: The update compares global surface temperatures
paragraphs.zh: 更新報告將全球地表溫度

paragraphs.en: from January to September
paragraphs.zh: 在1月至9月的數值，

paragraphs.en: with the average for 1850 to 1900.
paragraphs.zh: 與1850年至1900年的平均值相比。

paragraphs.en: The recent average is about 1.47 degrees Celsius higher.
paragraphs.zh: 今年這段期間的平均值約高出攝氏1.47度。

paragraphs.en: This is not a complete annual assessment:
paragraphs.zh: 這並非完整的全年評估：

paragraphs.en: the final report is due in March 2027.
paragraphs.zh: 最終報告預定於2027年3月發布。

paragraphs.en: The report also describes progress in early warnings.
paragraphs.zh: 報告也描述了預警方面的進展。

paragraphs.en: The report counts countries that reported
paragraphs.zh: 報告統計了回報

paragraphs.en: having systems for multiple hazards.
paragraphs.zh: 具有多災害預警系統的國家。

paragraphs.en: The total rose from 56 in 2015 to 136 in 2025.
paragraphs.zh: 總數從2015年的56國增加至2025年的136國。

paragraphs.en: These figures describe reported national systems.
paragraphs.zh: 這些數字描述的是各國回報的國家級系統。

paragraphs.en: They do not, by themselves, establish
paragraphs.zh: 單憑這些數字，並無法證明

paragraphs.en: that every community receives useful warnings.
paragraphs.zh: 每個社區都能收到有用的預警。

paragraphs.en: What makes a warning system effective?
paragraphs.zh: 什麼能讓預警系統發揮作用？

paragraphs.en: The UN Office for Disaster Risk Reduction
paragraphs.zh: 聯合國減災辦公室

paragraphs.en: identifies four connected elements.
paragraphs.zh: 列出了四個彼此相連的要素。

paragraphs.en: They include understanding risks, observing and forecasting hazards,
paragraphs.zh: 其中包括了解風險、觀測與預報災害，

paragraphs.en: communicating warnings, and preparing people to respond.
paragraphs.zh: 傳遞預警，以及讓民眾準備好採取應對行動。

paragraphs.en: The organisation stresses coordination among these elements.
paragraphs.zh: 該機構強調，這些要素之間必須協調合作。

paragraphs.en: A weakness in one part
paragraphs.zh: 任何一個環節的弱點，

paragraphs.en: can undermine the whole system.
paragraphs.zh: 都可能削弱整個系統。

paragraphs.en: This framework shows why accurate science
paragraphs.zh: 這個架構說明了，精準的科學

paragraphs.en: must be linked to communication and preparation.
paragraphs.zh: 為何必須與溝通及準備工作連結。

paragraphs.en: A forecast needs to reach the people at risk
paragraphs.zh: 預報必須傳達給面臨風險的人，

paragraphs.en: in a form they can understand and use.
paragraphs.zh: 並以他們能理解及運用的形式呈現。

paragraphs.en: Communities also need the ability to act on it.
paragraphs.zh: 社區也需要有能力依據預報採取行動。

paragraphs.en: Producing information and turning it into protection
paragraphs.zh: 產出資訊，以及將資訊轉化成保護措施，

paragraphs.en: are connected responsibilities.
paragraphs.zh: 是彼此相連的責任。

paragraphs.en: A message that arrives too late
paragraphs.zh: 過晚傳達的訊息，

paragraphs.en: or lacks clear instructions
paragraphs.zh: 或缺乏明確指示的訊息，

paragraphs.en: may fail to support timely action.
paragraphs.zh: 可能無法幫助民眾及時行動。

paragraphs.en: At a separate COP31 event on November 9,
paragraphs.zh: 在11月9日另一場COP31活動中，

paragraphs.en: WMO Secretary-General Celeste Saulo highlighted agriculture.
paragraphs.zh: WMO秘書長Celeste Saulo強調了農業議題。

paragraphs.en: She explained that forecasts can help farmers decide
paragraphs.zh: 她說明，預報能幫助農民決定

paragraphs.en: what to plant and when to water.
paragraphs.zh: 種植什麼，以及何時灌溉。

paragraphs.en: The value comes from connecting climate information
paragraphs.zh: 其價值來自將氣候資訊

paragraphs.en: with decisions made in fields.
paragraphs.zh: 與田間的實際決策連結起來。

paragraphs.en: Saulo called for strong national weather services
paragraphs.zh: Saulo呼籲建立強健的國家氣象服務，

paragraphs.en: to help information reach farming communities.
paragraphs.zh: 協助將資訊傳達給農業社區。

paragraphs.en: Finance and international cooperation were also discussed.
paragraphs.zh: 資金與國際合作也是討論議題。

paragraphs.en: WMO's opening-day coverage describes a session
paragraphs.zh: WMO的開幕日報導介紹了一場會議，

paragraphs.en: on funding observations, data exchange and forecasting.
paragraphs.zh: 內容涉及為觀測、資料交換與預報提供資金。

paragraphs.en: Countries shared how they estimate costs
paragraphs.zh: 各國分享了如何估算成本，

paragraphs.en: for warning systems and climate services
paragraphs.zh: 以建置預警系統及氣候服務，

paragraphs.en: in their national adaptation plans.
paragraphs.zh: 並將其納入國家調適計畫。

paragraphs.en: These discussions concern maintaining the wider infrastructure
paragraphs.zh: 這些討論關注的是維持更廣泛的基礎設施，

paragraphs.en: that makes local forecasts possible.
paragraphs.zh: 讓地方預報得以實現。

paragraphs.en: The opening-day messages therefore connect global measurements
paragraphs.zh: 因此，開幕日的訊息將全球量測結果

paragraphs.en: with local decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 與地方決策連結起來。

paragraphs.en: A scientific report can describe a changing climate,
paragraphs.zh: 科學報告能描述正在改變的氣候，

paragraphs.en: while a functioning warning system
paragraphs.zh: 而能正常運作的預警系統，

paragraphs.en: helps people prepare for its risks.
paragraphs.zh: 能幫助民眾為相關風險做好準備。

paragraphs.en: The practical challenge is to connect reliable observations,
paragraphs.zh: 實際挑戰是把可靠的觀測、

paragraphs.en: clear messages and the capacity to respond.
paragraphs.zh: 清楚的訊息與應對能力串連起來。

paragraphs.en: Progress depends on how well those links work together.
paragraphs.zh: 進展取決於這些環節能否有效合作。

adaptation.meaning: 調適；文中指因應氣候變遷影響的調整

among.meaning: 在…之間；文中指多個要素之間

are.meaning: 是；也可作被動語態的助動詞

at.meaning: 在；表示活動發生的場合

be.meaning: 是；與過去分詞連用可構成被動語態

capacity.meaning: 能力；文中指應對風險的能力

celeste.meaning: Celeste Saulo姓名的一部分；指世界氣象組織秘書長

cop.meaning: COP31中的字母部分，指聯合國氣候變化綱要公約締約方大會

depends.meaning: 取決於；depends on 指取決於

discussed.meaning: 討論了；過去分詞可與were構成被動語態

do.meaning: 助動詞，構成否定或疑問

due.meaning: 預定的；is due in指預定在某時發布

fail.meaning: 未能、無法；fail to指未能做某事

for.meaning: 為了、對於；也表示某時段的

in.meaning: 在某時間、領域或範圍中

is.meaning: 是；也可作被動或進行式的助動詞

it.meaning: 它；文中指預報或氣候資訊

its.meaning: 它的；文中指氣候或氣候更新報告的

made.meaning: 作出的；decisions made指所作出的決策

may.meaning: 可能；表示尚未確定的情況

of.meaning: …的；表示所屬、性質、內容等關係

or.meaning: 或；文中也用來引出另一稱呼，即WMO

organization.meaning: 組織；World Meteorological Organization指世界氣象組織

recent.meaning: 最近的；文中指2026年1月至9月

saulo.meaning: Saulo；世界氣象組織秘書長的姓氏

that.meaning: 那個；也可引導內容子句或關係子句

the.meaning: 定冠詞，指特定或前文提過的事物

their.meaning: 他們的、它們的；文中指各國的

they.meaning: 它們、他們；文中指數字、要素或人們

were.meaning: 是；與過去分詞連用，構成過去式被動語態

what.meaning: 什麼；引導疑問句或名詞子句

wmo.meaning: 世界氣象組織；World Meteorological Organization的縮寫

quiz.question: What is the main purpose of the article?

choices.text: To explain why climate observations must be connected to warnings and practical action.
choices.explanation: 正確。全文從COP31的氣候更新談到預警系統、農業決策與基礎設施，重點是讓資訊成為可用的防護。

choices.text: To announce that the final climate report for 2026 has already been completed.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第二段指出最終報告預定於2027年3月發布，目前並非完整全年評估。

choices.text: To compare the prices of farming equipment in different countries.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第六段討論預報如何幫助農業決策，沒有比較農具價格。

choices.text: To show that every community already receives reliable warnings.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第三段明確提醒，國家級系統數量不能證明每個社區都收到有用預警。

quiz.explanation: 主旨是連結全球氣候量測與地方的實際應對。科學報告、預報、訊息傳遞與社區應對能力必須串連，才能形成有效的預警系統。

evidence.quote: Its message connected rising climate risks with the practical need for better forecasts and warnings.
The practical challenge is to connect reliable observations, clear messages and the capacity to respond.

quiz.question: What can reasonably be inferred from the increase from 56 countries to 136 countries?

choices.text: Every resident in all 136 countries is guaranteed to receive useful warnings.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第三段明確指出這些數字無法證明所有社區都收到有用預警。

choices.text: The figures measure completed warning-system coverage in every community in 2026.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。數字指各國在2015年及2025年的回報，並非2026年逐一社區的完整涵蓋率。

choices.text: More countries reported having systems, but the figures alone do not prove universal access.
choices.explanation: 正確。數字顯示回報擁有系統的國家增加，不能直接推定每個社區都能取得預警。

choices.text: Countries no longer need to invest in communication or response capabilities.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第四、五段仍強調傳達訊息及應對能力的重要性。

quiz.explanation: 國家級回報數量是進展指標，但與每個社區實際接收及使用預警的情況不同。不能從國家數量直接推出全面涵蓋。

evidence.quote: These figures describe reported national systems. They do not, by themselves, establish that every community receives useful warnings.

quiz.question: Which situation would best reflect the effective warning system described in the article?

choices.text: Scientists produce a precise forecast that remains unavailable to affected communities.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第五段指出預報必須傳達給面臨風險的人。

choices.text: Communities receive understandable forecasts and have the ability to respond.
choices.explanation: 正確。第五段同時要求民眾能理解及使用預報，並有能力依據資訊行動。

choices.text: Authorities count national systems without considering whether their parts work together.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第四段強調各要素需要協調合作，不能只計算系統數量。

choices.text: Farmers receive a global report but cannot connect it with decisions in their fields.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第六段說明資訊的價值在於能與田間決策連結。

quiz.explanation: 有效預警不只需要科學預報，也需要民眾能接收、理解、運用資訊，並具備應對能力。只有選項B同時符合這些條件。

evidence.quote: A forecast needs to reach the people at risk in a form they can understand and use. Communities also need the ability to act on it.
